spots.bio: Observatory with a 70 cm telescope and public guided stargazing sessions in the River Murray Dark Sky Reserve.
spots.name: Swan Reach Observatory
spots.note: SATC attraction (Observatories): permanent observatory with a 70 cm telescope and public guided sessions in the Dark Sky Reserve (booking, from $85). Case against: ticketed night sessions only.

spots.bio: Local history museum in a 1917 school building at Swan Reach, with the Mid Murray Classic Car Gallery of 16+ vehicles.
spots.name: Swan Reach and District Museum
spots.note: SATC attraction listing and themurrayriver: local history museum in the 1917 school building (opened 2001). Small museum a guide names; hours not confirmed.

spots.bio: A 3,200 sq km Dark Sky Reserve along the Murray with stargazing sites and guided tours.
spots.wiki: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
spots.name: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
spots.note: Three SATC pages and parks.sa.gov.au name it: 3,200 sq km Dark Sky Reserve with stargazing sites (Milky Way visible), guided tours. Place to go whenever it is dark.

spots.bio: The tallest cliffs on the Murray at its longest bend, with a lookout near Nildottie and a free ferry at Walker Flat.
spots.name: Big Bend (Walker Flat)
spots.note: Mid Murray Council tourism ('Visit the majestic Big Bend cliffs') and themurrayriver: tallest cliffs on the Murray at the river's longest bend, lookout near Nildottie, free ferry at Walker Flat.

spots.bio: Five-million-year-old oyster-shell deposit that is also a Dark Sky viewing site.
spots.name: Shell Hill Reserve
spots.note: SATC and themurrayriver: 5-million-year-old oyster-shell deposit, listed Dark Sky viewing site. Small stop, geology a guide names.

spots.bio: Aboriginal heritage site at the Devon Downs rock shelter, visited on guided tours.
spots.name: Ngaut Ngaut Conservation Park
spots.note: Agency and SATC: Aboriginal heritage site (Devon Downs rock shelter) with guided tours; free.

spots.bio: Free clifftop lookout over the Murray, Blanchetown and Paisley Wetlands, 2.3 km off the Sturt Highway.
spots.name: Hunter Road Lookout
spots.note: Two SATC Riverland pages: free clifftop lookout over the Murray, Blanchetown and Paisley Wetlands, 2.3 km off the Sturt Highway at Paisley. In sa-murray-coorong (Riverland and Blanchetown).

spots.bio: Park known for the Three Habitat Walk and southern hairy-nosed wombats, with parts closed periodically.
spots.name: Brookfield Conservation Park
spots.note: Agency page names the Three Habitat Walk and southern hairy-nosed wombats; note part of park closed to public and periodic pest-control closures.

spots.bio: Art and sculpture trail along Karoonda's main street, beyond the silo art.
spots.name: Karoonda Art and Sculpture Trail
spots.note: themurrayriver.com 'Three of the best' names the Karoonda Art and Sculpture Trail along the main street, beyond the silo art (a separate spot).

spots.bio: Painted silos at Karoonda, a free permanent photo stop.
spots.name: Karoonda Day and Night Silo Art
spots.note: Painted silos named on southaustralia.com attractions and themurrayriver.com; free, permanent, photo stop (short visit, but a guide-named icon).

spots.bio: Pioneer buildings, machinery and rolling stock, with a 1 km nature trail, open to walk through.
spots.name: Pioneer Park (Karoonda)
spots.note: themurrayriver: pioneer buildings, machinery and rolling stock, 1 km nature trail, open to walk through at any time; also on SATC.

spots.bio: Two painted grain silos (Smug 2024, 2025 diptych) with a park beside them.
spots.name: Lameroo Silo Art
spots.note: themurrayriver and SATC: two painted grain silos (Smug 2024, 2025 diptych) with a park beside them; a roadside icon.
